createdFor: Phase 5 open-source reference and tool decision planning

tools.name: PLATEAU SDK for Unity GIS Sample
tools.expectedRole: Unity GIS visualization and PLATEAU-related display pattern reference.
adoptionConditions: review license and supported Unity/PLATEAU SDK version
extract concepts only unless a later Unity milestone approves code adoption
avoid sample project import
risks: sample assumptions may not match this project
boundaryNotes: do not import sample project directly
do not modify Unity Packages or ProjectSettings in P5-A1
tools.nextAction: Review concepts in P5-A2 or P5-C planning before any Unity integration.

tools.name: PLATEAU QGIS Plugin
tools.expectedRole: Manual QGIS inspection of PLATEAU/CityGML layers and spatial QA candidate.
adoptionConditions: confirm plugin maturity and QGIS version compatibility
use only for manual QA unless a later decision approves reproducible pipeline use
document any manual QA steps separately from pipeline outputs
risks: manual plugin state is not reproducible
boundaryNotes: not a required pipeline dependency in P5-A1
tools.nextAction: Evaluate as a visual QA aid during P5-B planning.

tools.name: OSMnx
tools.expectedRole: OSM pedestrian network retrieval, graph preparation, and prototype route generation.
adoptionConditions: review OSM license and attribution requirements
define cache/offline reproducibility policy
label outputs as estimated prototype routes
risks: routes are not official evacuation routes
boundaryNotes: do not treat OSM routes as official guidance
tools.nextAction: Review route reproducibility and attribution before P5-B implementation.

tools.name: GeoPandas
tools.expectedRole: Core vector geospatial processing, spatial joins, CRS-aware tables, and Unity-ready GeoJSON/CSV outputs.
adoptionConditions: choose stable Windows-compatible install path
define CRS policy and tests
pin version after dependency review
boundaryNotes: do not modify requirements.txt in P5-A1
tools.nextAction: Evaluate with Shapely, pyproj, and IO backend choices before P5-B.

tools.name: Shapely
tools.expectedRole: Geometry operations for contains, nearest, distance, buffer, intersection, and geometry validation.
adoptionConditions: use projected CRS for metric distances
validate geometry validity before matching
add tests for containment and nearest-building decisions
tools.nextAction: Define geometry test fixtures and CRS requirements before implementation.

tools.name: pyproj
tools.expectedRole: CRS transforms, coordinate validation, and reference point testing.
adoptionConditions: record input and output CRS in every processed dataset
define axis-order convention
test known reference points
boundaryNotes: future pipeline must record CRS metadata explicitly
tools.nextAction: Define CRS policy in P5-A2 rulebook/schema planning.

tools.name: NetworkX
tools.expectedRole: Graph routing support, potentially through OSMnx or direct graph operations.
adoptionConditions: confirm whether OSMnx already satisfies graph needs
define route cost model
confirm graph size and performance are acceptable
risks: route cost assumptions may be too simplistic
tools.nextAction: Evaluate only after the P5-B routing approach is selected.

tools.name: GDAL/Fiona/pyogrio
tools.expectedRole: Geospatial file IO backend for GeoJSON, GeoPackage, shapefile, and related vector formats.
adoptionConditions: identify actual official source formats
choose simplest stable Windows-compatible backend
avoid unnecessary heavy dependency footprint
boundaryNotes: do not modify requirements.txt in P5-A1
tools.nextAction: Choose IO backend after official source formats are confirmed.
